description: This file defines the IFirmwareUpdate interface for firmware management, including enums for update states and substates, notification mechanisms, and methods for updating firmware, retrieving update status, and setting auto-reboot.

classes.name: IFirmwareUpdate
classes.description: Interface for firmware update operations, including state management, notifications, and control methods.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback for firmware update events.

methods.name: UpdateFirmware
methods.description: Initiate a firmware update with specified file path and type.

methods.name: GetUpdateState
methods.description: Retrieve current firmware update status and substatus.

methods.name: SetAutoReboot
methods.description: Enable or disable auto-reboot after firmware update.
